description: Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Fine Particulate Matter (PM2.5) Hourly Data Port Hawkesbury BAM/T640 is a dataset listed in Province of Nova Scotia open data portal (data.novascotia.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of Nova Scotia. Hourly ambient fine particulate matter (PM2.5) data in micrograms per cubic metre from provincial ambient air quality monitoring stations across Nova Scotia up to the end of 2025. Coverage: Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the category Environment and Energy. Its tags are air quality, caaqs, canadian ambient air quality standards, environmental monitoring, environmental reporting. The table has 6 columns. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Nova Scotia Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-novascotia-ca-portal.
